examples.en: He is swift with his judgments.
Mr. Candidate was always careful of his judgments, and not afraid of teaching beginners.
examples.zh: 凯迪达特先生对自己的判断总是很谨慎，而且不怕教初学者。

examples.en: When the students were free to mimic the smiles, their judgments were not affected by what the salesclerk was doing.
examples.zh: 当学生们自由地模仿微笑时，他们的判断不受售货员行为的影响。
